description: Generate (or refresh) the product's growth plan and queue the first actions: the four-week plan, directory listings, first posts, a launch timeline, outreach and ad drafts. When the product has a goal (sync_context goals, e.g. "50 paying customers by January"), the plan is built against it: the horizon runs to the deadline, the weekly volume follows the pace the number needs, the channel mix favours what moves that metric, and every queued action carries a goalFit line. Returns right away with the step list and the goal as read; the work runs in the background for a few minutes. Call actions afterwards to see what was queued. Owner only.

force.description: Re-run on a product that already has a plan. Steps already done are skipped, not duplicated.

name: plan
title: Generate the growth plan
